usage.final_text:
I added `edit` and `list --pending`. `npm test` passes all 99 tests, including the new ones. I haven't committed anything.

**`edit <id> <text>`**
- It replaces only the text, so the todo keeps its id, completed status and `createdAt`.
- Like `add`, it joins unquoted words and trims whitespace, so `edit 1 Buy more milk` works.
- It prints `Edited todo <id>: <text>` on success.
- A missing id, an invalid id, missing or empty text, or an id that doesn't exist each print `Error: …` to stderr and exit 1. None of these touch `todos.json`, and none create it if it didn't exist.

**`list --pending`**
- It shows only incomplete todos, in the same `1. [ ] text` format as `list`.
- Plain `list` still shows everything.
- If nothing is pending, it prints `No pending todos.` rather than the "No todos yet" message, which would be misleading when completed todos exist.
- The flag is recognised anywhere after `list`. Other extra arguments are still ignored, as before.

I also updated the usage text and the README, and added `--pending` and `edit` cases to the existing corrupted-`todos.json` and `help` tests. The logic changes are in `lib/todo.js`. The new tests are in `test/cli.test.js` and `test/todo.test.js`.
